'''Rudy''' was a person who owned the [[Buick]] some time before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
In most literature concerning unlocking the Buick, references call the unlockable [[Groundcar/Legends|car]] "Rudy's Car". It is named so after [[Rudolf Stember]], an employee at [[Factor 5]] who owns the [[Wikipedia:Buick Electra|Buick Electra]] the in-game car is based on.
